Hiện nay, quy định luật giao thông đường.en: Currently, road traffic regulations set the fines for heavy transport vehicles. For the punishment to be clear, the state divided into two forms of goods that are hard goods and liquid goods. With hard goods, vehicles are allowed to carry heavy loads under 10%, and with liquid transports it is allowed to carry excesss under 20%. If any of the vehicles carry an excess load capacity, it will be fined.
Hiện nay, quy định luật giao thông đường.zh: 目前,道路交通条例对重型运输车辆规定了罚款。 为了明确惩罚,国家分为硬通货和液通货两种形式. 有硬通货的,允许车辆承载10%以下的重载;有液体运输的,允许承载20%以下的超载. 如果任何车辆载荷过剩,将处以罚款。

khối lượng hàng hóa tối đa mà ô tô có th.en: The maximum mass of goods that cars can transport. This census shows the transport capacity by technical safety standards that cars can meet. Carloads are usually written on car registration papers. This type of test paper is issued by the South Vietnamese audit agency if your car meets environmental and technical safety conditions. For example, the load of the car was 10 tons, meaning that the maximum weight the car could carry was 10 tons.
khối lượng hàng hóa tối đa mà ô tô có th.zh: 汽车可以运输的最大货物量. 这次普查按照汽车可以达到的技术安全标准显示运输能力. 车载通常会写在汽车登记证件上. 符合环境技术安全条件的,由南越审计机关出具此类试车证明. 例如,车载重量为10吨,意味着车载的最大重量为10吨.
